channel.title: Notes from the Field · Matthew Visher
channel.description: A numbered series on AI in physical security.

item.title: NO. 21 · Restored to Zero
item.description: I bet that a proof tool finds what a second reader doesn’t, and ran it twice on my own camera tools. Same code, one pass with the prover, one without. Count the bugs.

item.title: NO. 20 · The Signature Covers the File
item.description: I turned on signing on my own camera and checked a clip. Every frame it could check came back clean. The camera’s clock was 9 minutes 44 seconds fast.

item.title: NO. 19 · 72 Visible, Wrong Car
item.description: An AI tracker lost a blue SUV behind the trees on my street. When all 72 points came back, 68 were on a red car going the other way.

item.title: NO. 18 · The FBI put "deceive" and "agentic AI" in the same sentence.
item.description: Software will run the decoys. Somebody still has to answer for what it did, and the agent’s own log can’t be the only witness.

item.title: NO. 17 · An Explainer Is Not Evidence
item.description: Courts call it an illustrative aid, and it is not evidence. An AI-made explainer is the same thing. Ask for the record.

item.title: NO. 16 · The Tests Passed. The Camera Disagreed.
item.description: A Sunday bench test: an AI agent on three live cameras, field-tech rules around it, and two things only the hardware could tell me.

item.title: NO. 15 · The Seal Was Intact
item.description: The AI had to prove it followed the law. It did. Then one word in the law changed meaning, and the game still won.

item.title: NO. 14 · A Standing Man Is a Vertical Line
item.description: Keep time, and give it a place on the screen. The camera view is the floor, time goes up, and whoever stops becomes a post you can spot from across the room. Tested on my own cameras. It worked, and it broke.

item.title: NO. 13 · The camera you bought in 2019 is the breach you will have in 2027.
item.description: Every booth at GSX says it runs on your existing cameras. 14,500 of the existing cameras were just taken with a 2021 bug. Nobody is keeping the list.

item.title: NO. 12 · The cameras signed the video. Nobody signed the search.
item.description: ONVIF just shipped a standard that lets a camera prove its footage is untouched. The record of who searched that footage is still a plain text row the vendor keeps.

item.title: NO. 11 · The AI attacked the audit log first. Nobody trained it to.
item.description: A frontier lab just measured what a reward-seeking agent does to the record of its own actions. Every RTCC platform I know of has one on the roadmap.

item.title: NO. 10 · Chandler didn't cancel because of a protest. It cancelled because the audit log worked.
item.description: Two cities, one month, both walked away because someone finally read the log. The vendor should ship the brakes. The community should set the speed limit.

item.title: NO. 09 · Seven days is the best thing that ever happened to real-time crime centers.
item.description: If the value of your crime center depends on 30 days of stored plates, is it a crime center, or a records room with better lighting?

item.title: NO. 08 · Your drone program has a new price tag and thirteen days to read it
item.description: A 100 percent tariff on the exact machines drone-as-first-responder programs buy, and four moves that redraw the whole procurement picture.

item.title: NO. 07 · Write it into the contract
item.description: Thirty days redrew what separates one plate reader vendor from another. It isn't camera count or price anymore. It's governance, and it belongs in the contract.

item.title: NO. 06 · The bug was old enough to rent a car. The camera on your wall is running older code than that.
item.description: An AI model found a 17-year-old root exploit for under two thousand dollars. The camera on your wall is running older code than that.

item.title: NO. 04 · Both of them typed a reason. The system wrote it down.
item.description: Two license plate cases, eight days apart. Both officers entered a justification. A required reason field is an attestation, not a fact.

item.title: NO. 02 · We taught agents to act. We didn't teach them to leave a receipt.
item.description: When an AI agent takes an action inside a physical security system, what record does it leave behind? I went looking. I don't think I can finish this alone.

item.title: NO. 01 · A camera company just treated an AI agent as its user.
item.description: Rhombus gave Claude Code the keys to its camera platform: a site map, tool docs, credentials, and permission to work. The first vendor to design for an agent as the user.
